entity.spawn.angler_fish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Deep Waters. Can be fed shiny items to be granted with Night Vision. Deflates on Land. Fits in a bucket.

entity.spawn.tuna.description: An aquatic passive mob that can be bred. Doesn't fit in a Bucket when grown up.
lore.spawn.tuna_chunk: Collected by killing Tuna, can be eaten raw or cooked.

lore.spawn.tuna_slice: Tuna Chunks sliced into smaller bits.

lore.spawn.seahorse_bucket: A bucket with a Seahorse inside.
lore.spawn.music_disc_water_horse: A music disc that can be collected by killing a baby Drowned while it's riding a Seahorse, and can be played in a Jukebox. It's an uncommon find.
entity.spawn.snail.description: A passive mob found in forests that produces Mucus when wet. It has a shell that can be knocked off with Projectiles and retreated into for protection.

lore.spawn.potted_sweet_berry_bush: A Snail Shell holding Sweet Berries, prevents prickling.
lore.spawn.mucus: A Snail's Trail, slows entities that walk on it.

advancements.spawn.obtain_mucus.title: Snailed It

advancements.spawn.went_through_ghostly_: Pass through a Ghostly Mucus Block
entity.spawn.hamster.description: A passive mob found in open grassy areas that can be tamed with Sunflower Seeds. It collects items and stores them in its cheek pouches, which can be accessed by its owner. Territorial and energetic, cannot withstand extreme temperatures.
lore.spawn.dried_hamster: A flattened, dried Hamster, can be brought back to life with Water.
lore.spawn.hamster_wheel: A decorative block that Hamsters run inside of. Emits Redstone Power when in use.
lore.spawn.sunflower: A flower that can be harvested for its Seeds or crafted into Yellow Dye. It follows the Sun and regrows Seeds in the Morning.
lore.spawn.sunflower_seeds: An item that can be planted to grow a Sunflower.
lore.spawn.roasted_sunflower_seeds: An item that restores a small amount of saturation. Can be eaten fast.
advancements.spawn.open_hamster_inventor: Open the cheek pouch of a Tamed Hamster

lore.spawn.rotten_log_anthill: A block that may have ants hiding inside. Randomly rots a 3x1x3 area below it when full.
lore.spawn.ant_farm: A synthetic Anthill that may have ants hiding inside. Randomly rots a 3x1x3 area below it when full.
lore.spawn.rotten_button: A block that emits Redstone Power for 5 seconds when pressed.
entity.spawn.boat.description: A two-passenger vehicle for traversing rivers and oceans.
entity.spawn.chest_boat.description: A single-passenger vehicle that has its own storage.
lore.spawn.fallen_leaves: A rotten version of a Leaves block.
lore.spawn.music_disc_rot: An item that can be played in a Jukebox. Found in Ant Mounts. It's an uncommon find.
lore.spawn.ant_pupa: An item that spawns a tamed baby Ant.

entity.spawn.clam.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Oceans and Beaches. Can be collected by hand and with a Casting Net.
